scope: Six Portuguese Google Play descriptions: same Easybrain, Oakever, Brainium, Andoku, Guru and GamoVation samples as English/German/Spanish. Four retrieved with hl=pt_BR; Oakever and Andoku pt_BR endpoints failed, so their actual hl=pt descriptions are transparently included as Portuguese fallback. Not six independently verified Brazil-specific listings or a market/download ranking.
method: NFC, lowercase, whitespace collapse, curly apostrophes normalized to straight apostrophes and dash variants to hyphen. Exact contiguous phrases delimited by Unicode letters/digits. Accents retained; singular/plural, compound forms, synonyms and spelling remain distinct. Body between Sobre este jogo and Atualizado em, including public short description if supplied. Excludes title, tags, reviews, screenshots, related-app cards and linked sites; literal URLs/emails within body remain part of sampled text. Nested rows can overlap. Cache/region and mixed pt_BR/pt sources limit interpretation. Full competitor prose is not persisted.
